title: CSV to YAML Converter – Rows as a YAML List | OpenAnyDoc
description: Convert CSV to YAML in your browser: a list with one mapping per row, where codes such as 007 and phone numbers stay text. Copy or download a .yaml file.
heading: CSV to YAML Converter
subtitle: Drop a CSV and its YAML list appears at once, one mapping per row, ready to copy or download.
intro: Turn a spreadsheet export into YAML for fixtures, seed data, a static site's data folder or an Ansible inventory. Choose, drop or paste a CSV or TSV file and the YAML appears at once: a list with one mapping per row, keyed by the header row. Plain decimals become YAML numbers; codes such as 007, phone numbers and long IDs stay text, so nothing loses a digit. Arabic is written as it is, not as escape codes. The delimiter and encoding are detected for you, and the conversion runs in your browser.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your CSV is turned into YAML by your own browser and never sent to a server.

features.title: Codes stay intact
features.text: Only plain decimals become numbers; 007, phone numbers and long IDs stay text, so the YAML reads back as your data.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, it keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How it works: convert CSV to YAML

steps.title: Add your CSV
steps.text: Choose or drop a .csv or .tsv file, paste CSV text into the box, or try a sample. The delimiter and encoding are detected for you.

steps.title: Read the YAML
steps.text: Each row becomes a list item starting with a dash, with one key per column from the header row.

steps.title: Copy or download
steps.text: Copy the YAML to your clipboard or download it as a .yaml file with the CSV's name.

handlesTitle: What the CSV to YAML converter handles
handles: Files: .csv and .tsv, or CSV text you paste; comma, semicolon, tab and pipe delimiters.
Encodings: UTF-8, UTF-16 and Windows-1256 Arabic, detected automatically.
Shape: a YAML list with one mapping per row, keyed by the header row.
Numbers: plain decimals such as 42 or 3.5 become numbers; 007, phone numbers and long IDs stay text.
Arabic and other non-Latin text written as it is, not as escape codes.
Quoted CSV fields with commas or line breaks inside, as Excel and Google Sheets write them.
limits: The first row is read as the keys, so it should hold the column names.
Every row becomes a flat mapping; the converter does not build nested YAML from column names.
The preview shows the first 5,000 lines; Copy and Download always take the whole YAML.
faqTitle: CSV to YAML: questions and answers

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your browser reads the CSV and writes the YAML on your device. Pasted text stays in this tab and is never sent anywhere.

faq.question: What shape does the YAML take?
faq.answer: A list: each CSV row becomes one item that starts with a dash, and each column becomes a key from the header row with that row's value.

faq.question: Why did 007 stay in quotes?
faq.answer: Written as a number, 007 would become 7. Only plain decimals become YAML numbers; codes with leading zeros, phone numbers and long IDs stay text so they read back unchanged.

faq.question: Can I get nested YAML from columns like address.city?
faq.answer: No. Each row becomes a flat mapping and a header such as address.city stays one key. Nest it by hand after converting if your tool needs it.

faq.question: Is Arabic text kept readable?
faq.answer: Yes. Arabic and other non-Latin text is written as it is in UTF-8, not as \u escape codes, so you can read and edit the YAML directly.

faq.question: Can I convert YAML back to JSON?
faq.answer: Yes, on the YAML to JSON page, which opens a .yaml or .yml file as JSON.

faq.question: How do I convert a CSV file to YAML?
faq.answer: Open or paste the CSV and each row becomes a YAML list item with one key per column; copy it or download it as a .yaml file. OpenAnyDoc converts it in your browser, without uploading the data.
